notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Greenwarden of Murasa is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that's tapped and attacking.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
